publicJourneyCases.qualification: Seven passed together; Chromium full-path case hit an HTTP503 on a static JPEG during baseline saving and passed on targeted rerun.

publicActivationCases.chromium: Lost ACTIVATE → explicit failure → keyboard retry → both tabs reloaded, marker preserved

capture.environment: Headful Chromium, virtual X11 desktop, explicit app Start and automated chooser; no physical-device/chooser claim

recipe.commandLine: ffmpeg -i capture.webm -filter_complex '[0:v:0]fps=12,trim=start=0:end=1.25,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,scale=w='\''trunc(min(1280,iw)/2)*2'\'':h=-2[v0];[0:v:0]fps=12,trim=start=2:end=4.5,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,scale=w='\''trunc(min(1280,iw)/2)*2'\'':h=-2[v1];[v0][v1]concat=n=2:v=1:a=0[v]' -map '[v]' -an -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -crf 23 -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 12 -movflags +faststart edited-demo.mp4

upgrade.qualification: Upgrade navigation began successfully; an initial verifier read raced reload. Reopening the persistent profile verified the completed new bundle/cache and preserved marker.
